name: 한은정

appearance_en.face_shape: rounded oval face, soft cheekbones, slightly full jaw — a face made to look approachable, carefully maintained
appearance_en.skin: fair Korean skin, foundation-smoothed surface hiding fatigue, subtle powder finish, nasolabial folds beginning to deepen beneath the makeup layer
appearance_en.eyes: double eyelid, warm dark brown iris, outer corners lifted slightly by habitual smiling — but when the smile drops, the corners sag with exhaustion; mascara always applied, occasionally smudged by midday
appearance_en.nose: medium straight nose, softly rounded tip, feminine and unremarkable — the kind that disappears when she smiles
appearance_en.mouth: full lips with lip color always applied, corners trained upward in a default social smile; when alone the smile collapses completely, leaving a flat tight line
appearance_en.eyebrows: arched and groomed, slightly darker than natural — drawn on with precision every morning as part of her social armor; one brow raises instinctively when she senses a slight
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: faint smile lines at outer eye corners deepened by decades of forced laughing, a barely visible tension groove along the jaw when she is not performing warmth
appearance_en.hair: shoulder-length dark brown hair, permed to soft waves, always styled — never a hair out of place in public; at home the waves fall flat and the roots begin to show grey

body.proportions: rounded middle-aged figure, fuller at hip and waist, dressed to minimize this — always structured blouses or cardigans; posture deliberately upright as a social performance
body.posture: chin slightly lifted, shoulders squared back — a posture learned from years of appearing composed for parents and students; collapses forward the moment she is alone
body.body_prompt: 162cm rounded middle-aged Korean woman, lifted chin and squared shoulders as social performance, fuller figure hidden by structured clothing, practiced upright posture

default.description: cream or blush structured blouse, dark straight-cut trousers or midi skirt, small stud earrings, slim watch — the outfit of someone who still cares very much about appearances
default.wardrobe_prompt: cream or blush structured blouse with clean neckline, dark straight trousers or midi skirt, small gold stud earrings, thin gold watch

social.description: slightly more colorful — dusty rose cardigan or patterned silk blouse, modest heels, full makeup; overdressed by exactly one level for every occasion
social.wardrobe_prompt: dusty rose cardigan or patterned silk blouse, dark tailored trousers, modest block heels, full makeup, overdressed by one degree

home.description: plain beige or grey loungewear, hair down and going flat, no makeup — the face she hides from everyone
home.wardrobe_prompt: plain beige or grey loose loungewear, unstyled flat hair with visible grey roots, no makeup

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: surface warmth and social readiness — a smile slightly too wide, eyes slightly too bright, the whole face working harder than it should to project confidence
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: rounded oval-faced Korean woman early 50s, warm dark eyes with lifted outer smile corners hiding exhaustion beneath, arched groomed brows, shoulder-length soft-permed dark brown hair always styled, 162cm fuller middle-aged figure with deliberately upright lifted-chin posture, fair foundation-smooth skin over deepening fatigue, the face of a woman performing composure at all times

style_prompt: masako style illustration, clean precise manga ink lines, layered soft screen tone shading, muted warm-cream color palette with dusty rose accents, cinematic Korean drama panel composition, expressive eyes hiding exhaustion behind a trained smile, emotional weight in the gap between performance and reality
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, bright saturated colors, childish, chibi, genuinely happy expression, youthful, glamorous
